meta.name: Formula 1 Channel
meta.description:
Formula 1 is a sport like no other and the Formula 1 Channel is the ultimate destination to catch up on all the action from F1, F2, F3 and F1 Academy races throughout the season, including analysis, replays and documentaries.

Shows: Formula 1 Racing, Formula 1 Racing: 2026, Race in 30, Pre-Sprint Show: Singapore 2026, Pre-Qualifying Show: Singapore 2026
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
